units.say: I want to talk about the one habit that changed how I work.
For years I would sit down at my desk and just stare at the screen, waiting for the right moment to start.
Then a friend told me about the two minute rule.
Then a friend of mine told me about the two minute rule.
If something takes less than two minutes, you do it right away, no planning, no list.
It sounds simple, and it is, but the effect on the rest of the day is huge.
The first week I cleared my inbox, I paid three bills, and I finally fixed the squeaky door.
The second week I noticed I was starting bigger tasks the same way, just the first two minutes.
So that's the rule. Start for two minutes, and let momentum do the rest.
